title: Medication Setup Charge on a Respite and Short-Term Stay
content:
A stay whose type includes medication administration carries one medication setup charge for pharmacy packaging and the medication administration record, posted as an add-on on the stay once the physician's report for the stay is on file. This is the medication setup charge of the Respite and Short-Term Stay Agreement.

## When a stay carries it

| Stay type includes medication administration | Physician's report for the stay on file | Medication setup charge |
|---|---|---|
| Yes | Yes | One charge, posted as an add-on on the stay |
| Yes | Not yet | Posted once the report is on file |

Whether a stay type includes medication administration is shown on the stay type's schedule of included services; the date of the physician's report is the health documents date recorded on the stay.

## What the posting does

- It records one add-on charge entry on the stay account — the medication setup charge — dated today, with today as the service date and a quantity of one.
- It raises the stay balance by the charge; the guest sees the charge on the stay statement and a higher balance owed.

## How it is invoked

The charge is posted with the agent-side tool `post_medication_setup_fee_0971281c`. The agent unlocks the tool and then calls it; one call records one charge entry.

## Parameters

| Parameter | What it is | Format |
|---|---|---|
| `respite_stay_id` | Reference number of the respite or trial stay being charged, as returned by the stay lookup | Identifier |
| `setup_amount` | Amount of the medication setup charge in USD | Positive number with 2 decimal places, already rounded half up to the cent |

## Return

A confirmation sentence naming the new charge entry reference number, the stay reference number, the charge in USD with 2 decimal places and the resulting stay balance. A returned entry reference number means the charge was posted.
